temperature.note: No archive holds a spectrum of this star (stis-ngsl: HD 216899 is not in the library; gaia-xp: Gaia DR3 published no sampled BP/RP spectrum of it; pulkovo: no HR number; kiehling: no HR number; kharitonov: no HR number; burnashev: no HR (BS) number), so the color is a Planck spectrum at its published temperature.
